M5 — 2026-10-04
To tell 'a hook never ran' from 'it ran and filed nothing', read the private diagnostics store: ~/.local/state/sofar/diagnostics/<clone key>/<slug>.jsonl has one tool_outcome or tool_failure row per classified hook call, by session. Claude Code transcripts record a PostToolUse attachment only when the hook printed output, so a silent hook leaves no trace there.
